rationale: The five candles since entry have printed a steady sequence of higher highs and higher closes (26.61 → 26.66 → 26.70 → 26.72 → 26.70), directly contradicting the lower-high, lower-low structure that justified the short; the maximum favorable excursion was only 0.34% and price has fully mean-reverted back to entry. Volume is collapsing on the up-drift (11,721 → 3,149), which removes the "exhaustion" cover, and the 9-EMA at $26.72 is being reclaimed, undermining the key momentum signal from the original setup. With the short thesis mechanically invalidated by price behaviour—even though the hard stop at $26.92 has not been touched—exiting now at breakeven preserves capital and avoids holding a position whose edge has dissipated.
